{{Quote|We squashed the smuggling ring a few days ago. But House Thul's got plenty of CryoBan weapons already.|translated=1|Aza Gundo mentions the takedown of the smuggling ring|<ref name="TORFA" />}}
A '''smuggling''' ring delivered [[CryoBan grenade/Legends|CryoBan]] weapons to the [[House of Thul]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] while they were backed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ring was shut down by Republic forces in [[3643 BBY]].

==History==
The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] ring was in operation during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The ring smuggled illegal [[CryoBan/Legends|CryoBan]] weapons, including [[CryoBan rifle/Legends|rifles]] and [[CryoBan cell]]s, onto the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] for the [[House of Thul]], one of the [[Great Houses of Alderaan]] supported by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The weapons were then used by Thul [[Troop/Legends|troops]] in the [[Alderaan Civil War]] against the Republic backed [[House of Organa/Legends|House of Organa]]. However, the ring was shut down by Republic forces<ref name="TORFA" /> in [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="dates" /> after a [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Private/Legends|private]] named [[Aza Gundo]] became aware of its existence due to connections he had with criminals he knew from before joining the [[Republic Army]]. Despite the ring's destruction, a large amount of CryoBan weapons were already in circulation among the troops of House Thul.<ref name="TORFA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The CryoBan weapons delivered to the House of Thul troops by the ring were destroyed by a Republic-aligned individual who Gundo tasked with the job several [[Standard day/Legends|days]] after the ring was taken down.<ref name="TORFA" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ring was first mentioned in the quest "Frozen Assets" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]]. The quest requires players to destroy the CryoBan weapons, and while it is optional, this article assumes players completed the quest in order to achieve 100% game completion.
